title: Al-Muddaththir 74:1-10 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 1: Al-Muddaththir and madd in recitation
source: Written for quran/y9 lesson 13 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Al-Muddaththir 74:1-10 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 13. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمُدَّثِّرُ (١) قُمْ فَأَنذِرْ (٢) وَرَبَّكَ فَكَبِّرْ (٣) وَثِيَابَكَ فَطَهِّرْ (٤) وَٱلرُّجْزَ فَٱهْجُرْ (٥) وَلَا تَمْنُن تَسْتَكْثِرُ (٦) وَلِرَبِّكَ فَٱصْبِرْ (٧) فَإِذَا نُقِرَ فِى ٱلنَّاقُورِ (٨) فَذَٰلِكَ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَوْمٌ عَسِيرٌ (٩) عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ غَيْرُ يَسِيرٍۢ (١٠)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: O you who covers himself [with a garment], Arise and warn
And your Lord glorify And your clothing purify
And uncleanliness avoid And do not confer favor to acquire more
But for your Lord be patient. And when the trumpet is blown,
That Day will be a difficult day For the disbelievers - not easy.

keywords.def: the one wrapped in a cloak

questions.q: Chunk and link Al-Muddaththir 74:1-10 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 74:1-10 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 74:1-10 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: In the portal box, list the six commands in 74:2 to 7 and one modern way to live each.
questions.a: Arise and warn; glorify Allah; purify clothing; avoid uncleanliness; give without seeking more; be patient: each with a sensible example.

questions.q: Explain how 74:6 'do not confer favour to acquire more' links to sincerity.
questions.a: Give for Allah, not to get more back; that is ikhlas.

questions.q: Which command is NOT in 74:2 to 7?
questions.a: A) Travel the earth. 74:2 to 7: arise and warn, glorify your Lord, purify your clothing, avoid uncleanliness, do not give to gain more, be patient for your Lord.

questions.q: Think again: 'O you who covers himself, arise and warn!' These words came early in the Prophet's ﷺ mission. What do they ask of him, and of us?
questions.a: To stand up for the message: magnify Allah, purify oneself, avoid wrong, be patient for Allah (74:1 to 7).
